published_requirement.statement: Data outside the training-data bounds must be null or NaN; one float32 layer; EPSG:32611; 100 m; matching bounds; values in [0,1].
published_requirement.source_scope: Public problem-format page; confirms published instructions, not organizer acceptance of this artifact or authentication of local mirror bytes.

footprint_basis.basis: footprint count recorded in the original H49 build receipt against an owner-supplied mirrored sample_submission.tif; the mask was not re-restored or independently re-derived during this review.

assessment.reason: The read-back has no NaN, no nodata tag, and a valid GDAL mask on all 12,279,160 cells. Relative to the recorded 5,167,373-cell mirrored footprint, 7,111,787 cells are outside but remain finite/valid. This does not meet the published null-or-NaN-outside requirement.

provenance_notes: This review read the already-present TIFF only; it did not restore source data, rerun H47-B or H49, upload, or use a competition slot.

The earlier builder receipt's every-cell-finite check did not test that outside-footprint cells were null or NaN. Its all_checks_passed field is retained as historical evidence, not accepted as a published-format pass.
The mirror footprint count and TIFF geometry are owner-supplied repository evidence; their consistency does not authenticate organizer provenance.
